units.length: px at scale 1. Every instance multiplies every length (bounds, prop positions, hop dx excluded) by its own scale.
units.origin: the anchor: the ground contact point, bottom centre of the character at rest. The anchor never moves inside an action.
units.axes: x grows to the right, y grows down (SVG). All numbers in this file are relative to the anchor.
units.time: seconds from the start of the action; frame = round(t*30).
units.scale: uniform; drawn size = value * instance scale. A prop scale of 1 is its designed size (pebble r=22, crumb r=13, cloth width 260, slot r=40).
units.dir: +1 puts props and the lean toward the right, -1 toward the left. The art is never mirrored: the silhouettes are asymmetric on purpose. Values that depend on dir are listed per dir ("1" and "-1"); for actions without a dir parameter only "1" exists and applies to every use.
units.dx: hop only, in game units (the same units as g.x). The runtime moves the grain from 0 to dx during the flight and adds dx to g.x when the hop completes. Bounds for hop are measured with dx=0: extend them by the segment [0, dx].
units.bounds: x:[min,max], y:[min,max] over the whole action: character (white outline included), props, fx, shadow, and draw = their union. Use draw to size a clip region or to keep an action away from edges.

cancelPolicy.behavior: cancel() snaps to the resting loop of the action's start state, emits {type:"cancel"} only, never "end", and no further events from the cancelled action.

events.end: an action completed normally; carries props: the final state of every prop of that action (anchor-local, scale 1) so the game can keep an object the action moved
events.cancel: a cancelable action was cancelled in place
events.bite: eat: a bite lands on the crumb
events.contact: push/ritual: the grain touches the prop

propDistance.note: where this character's props sit on the ground, from the anchor along dir, at scale 1

idle.description: alert rest with a gentle blink

curious.description: a look and a tilt toward dir

hop.description: full hop: prep, takeoff, landing, settle; optional dx
hop.position: runtime moves the anchor by dx during the flight

eat.description: walks to the crumb, bites three times (each bite shrinks it), reacts in its own way, walks back
eat.position: the grain travels inside the action and ends on its anchor

pet.description: reaction to a pet on top (touch at t=0)

push.description: one careful nudge; the pebble rolls 36 px further out and stays there

refuse.description: when full: looks, bumps the crumb gently aside, shrugs, walks back
refuse.position: the grain travels inside the action and ends on its anchor
